text:
If a video has a frame rate of 60 frames per second, how many frames occur in 2.5 minutes?
First, 2.5 minutes equals 150 seconds. Multiplying 150 seconds by 60 frames per second yields exactly 9,000 frames rendered in total.

text:
What is the uncompressed bit depth size of 10 seconds of 24-bit 96kHz stereo PCM audio?
Multiplying 96,000 samples per second by 3 bytes per sample (24 bits) by 2 stereo channels equals 576,000 bytes per second. For 10 seconds, that totals 5,760,000 bytes (approximately 5.49 megabytes).

text: Truly helpful dialogue feels natural because the speaker adapts to context rather than reciting static scripts. When a user mentions a problem in passing and then asks a brief follow-up such as 'What should I try if that fails?', a reliable assistant remembers the earlier topic without asking the person to repeat everything. Good communication also knows its own boundaries. If a question depends on missing context—for instance, asking for a quote from a video that has no loaded transcript—stating honestly what is missing builds far more trust than inventing a plausible-sounding guess. Similarly, whenever exact numerical facts are needed, such as computing file bitrate, duration percentages, or PCM sample counts, delegating arithmetic to deterministic functions ensures precision while allowing natural language to explain what those numbers mean in everyday practice.

text:
How do I load external subtitles and fix timing offset?
Follow these steps: 1. Drag and drop your .srt or .vtt subtitle file directly into the video player canvas. 2. If subtitles appear too early or too late, open the Subtitle settings panel. 3. Use the Subtitle Offset slider to adjust timing forward or backward in 100 millisecond increments until text matches speech.

text:
Why won't my MKV file play with audio in the browser?
Matroska (.mkv) files often contain audio codecs like AC-3 or DTS which standard web browsers cannot demux natively. To fix this, remux or export your video to an MP4 container with H.264 video and AAC audio, or a WebM container with VP9 and Opus audio.

text:
Explain what occurs during subtitle synchronization.
Subtitle synchronization applies an offset to all cue timestamps simultaneously. If dialogue begins before the captions appear, applying a positive offset shifts captions earlier in time so that text and voice match precisely.

text:
What is the Pythagorean theorem for right triangles?
The Pythagorean theorem states that in any right triangle, the square of the length of the hypotenuse c is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides a and b: a^2 + b^2 = c^2.

The mean is the arithmetic average of a dataset, the median is the middle value when data is sorted in ascending order, and the mode is the most frequently occurring value.

text:
What is the derivative of x^n with respect to x?
By the basic power rule of differential calculus, the derivative of x^n with respect to x is equal to n * x^(n - 1) for any real number exponent n.

Smart Media Organizer එකේ Duplicates tab එකට යන්න. එතැනදී identical hash තියෙන duplicates list වෙනවා. අනවශ්‍ය copy එක select කරලා delete කරන්න.

text:
Background noise එක අඩු කරගන්නේ කොහොමද?
Web Audio Studio එකේ 32Hz සහ 64Hz low-end sliders පහළට දමන්න. Low-cut filter එකෙන් fan noise සහ room rumble සෑහෙන දුරට ඉවත් වෙනවා.

text:
Speech pacing metric එකෙන් මනින්නේ මොකක්ද?
වීඩියෝ එකේ කථිකයා විනාඩියකට වචන කීයක් කතා කරනවාද (Words Per Minute) කියන එක speech pacing එකෙන් මනිනවා. Normal pacing එක 130-160 WPM වේ.
